Celebrating America Through Song: Behind EPCOT's Voices of Liberty
For generations of EPCOT guests visiting the Walt Disney World Resort, the Voices of Liberty have been more than a performance, they've been an American tradition. 🎶 🇺🇸

To celebrate America's 250th, for the first time ever, go behind the scenes with the acclaimed a cappella ensemble as cast members and former singers share the history, legacy, and personal stories that have shaped one of EPCOT's most beloved entertainment offerings.

Step inside rehearsals, hear never-before-shared memories, and discover the dedication that goes into preserving the rich sound and spirit of Voices of Liberty. Through heartfelt interviews and rare backstage access, performers reflect on the friendships, milestones, and unforgettable moments that have defined their journeys over decades of singing beneath the rotunda of The American Adventure.

Whether you've stopped to listen for a few minutes or have made Voices of Liberty a must-do part of every EPCOT visit, this special look celebrates the people, passion, and harmony that continue to inspire guests from around the world.

Becoming Moana: A Visit With Catherine Laga’aia | Disney Files On Demand
Stepping into her dream role as our favorite wayfinding warrior in Walt Disney Studios’ live-action adaptation of “Moana,” opening in theaters July 10th, Catherine Laga’aia sits down for a visit with Disney Files Magazine Editor Ryan March inside the Island Tower addition at Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows. 

During their visit, Catherine reflects on becoming Moana – from her whirlwind audition process to working with Auli’i Cravalho (voice of Moana in the animated films, and an Executive Producer on the live-action film) to what it means to her to represent her culture on screen.

NEW EPISODE! #TheMuppets got a roller coaster 🎢 Disney Unscripted got the backstage access 🎸🎬
In this episode of Disney Unscripted, go behind the scenes with Walt Disney Imagineering, Disney Live Entertainment, musicians, celebrity guests, and cast members as they transform one of Disney's most thrilling attractions into a wild ride headlined by Dr. Teeth and The Electric Mayhem.

From recording all-new music tracks and programming onboard audio to repainting the attraction's iconic guitar and reimagining the queue and pre-show experience, see how creative teams worked together to bring this high-energy adventure to life. You'll also get an inside look at attraction testing, final show adjustments, and the many details that had to come together before opening day.

Then, join The Electric Mayhem and special guests as they celebrate the grand opening before fans experience the attraction for the very first time. Discover how Disney Imagineers blended music, storytelling, technology, and a little bit of Muppet mayhem to create a brand-new chapter for this fan-favorite coaster.
